positions.title: Software Engineering Coach
positions.description:
Lectured twice a week on Redux, Algorithms, React, JavaScript, etc. 
Repaired over 400 bugs for our online curriculum platform. 
Gained mastery of Ruby, Rails, JavaScript, React and Redux.
Was selected to work on the Pilot Curriculum Program, creating and checking new lessons. 
Provided support and worked with the students to ensure their learning success.

positions.title: Casino Dealer
positions.description:
Dealt 7 types of games, enforced rules, dealt according to strict procedure. 
Provided a positive customer service experience.

positions.title: QA Tester
positions.description:
Worked as part of the support team testing several unreleased Activision games. 
Completed tests and assessments to ensure quality. Wrote 300 + bugs.
Eventually promoted to work on Call of Duty: Modern Warfare.
